name: Ralmitaront
summary: Ralmitaront is an investigational antipsychotic drug which was undergoing a Phase II clinical trial for the treatment of negative symptoms in schizophrenia and schizoaffective disorder, but the trial was discontinued due to lack of efficacy. Another Phase II clinical trial targeting acute psychotic symptoms of schizophrenia was also terminated for the same reason. It is a partial agonist of the TAAR1 protein.
